boundaries: Events are partial updates, not complete account snapshots.
Missing P never implies closure; explicit zero quantities are handled per symbol and position side.
Wallet balances are absolute wb/cw, not bc or cr deltas.
Unsupported risk fields and aggregate balances require signed REST verification.
Event E orders each key; transaction T compares with REST per-record updateTime; local receive clock is not a sequence.
Disconnects still require explicit complete signed reads; no automatic wallet prompts.
prd_requirements: Futures Positions: account events update positions and balances; public Mark Price updates estimates.
Retain explicit abnormal and historical states; reconnect requires a complete account recheck.
Position quantity, entry price and financial units remain precise; unavailable liquidation price stays unknown.
